name: Viboplr Community
author: Viboplr
description: Viboplr Community inside the app: a Community tab on every song, album and artist page — like and comment, import shared cue sheets and synced lyrics — plus publishing your own cue sheets, lyrics and playlists, and taking a mixtape or sheet from the website into the app. Browsing is on the website. Sign in with GitHub to share, like or comment; importing needs no account.

permissionReasons.network:community.viboplr.com: See and import what's shared, publish your own, like and comment, and send plays, likes and waveforms when switched on
permissionReasons.system:open: Sign in with GitHub in your browser, and open Community pages on the website
permissionReasons.cues:read: Check for a cue sheet before an import replaces it, and list your own sheets so you can publish them
permissionReasons.cues:write: Install a shared cue sheet you chose to import
permissionReasons.playback:read: Find what's shared for the playing song, pin a comment to its current moment, publish your queue, send plays, and look up or share its waveform when switched on
permissionReasons.library:read: Read playlists and cached lyrics you publish, match songs to your library, and send likes when switched on
permissionReasons.library:write: Save a mixtape you chose to your playlists, and replace it with its newer version when you update it
permissionReasons.lyrics:write: Make shared synced lyrics you chose to import the song's lyrics
permissionReasons.plugins:call: Get a song's synced lyrics from your lyrics providers to publish them, and again when you undo an import
permissionReasons.playback:markers: Show timed comments as ticks on the seek bar, when that's switched on
permissionReasons.ui:read: Offer a shared cue sheet only while Now Playing is on your screen, not for every song played in the background

viewHeader.subtitle: Share from this computer; browse everything on the website

assistant.instructions: Viboplr Community shares cue sheets, synced lyrics and mixtapes between users. publish_lyrics sends the synced lyrics Viboplr already has for a song to the community server, under the signed-in user's account. It never takes lyrics from you: to share lyrics you have fixed, save them for the song in Viboplr first. Check with get_lyrics that the song has kind=synced, and only publish when the user asked. It fails, with the reason, when the user isn't signed in (you can't sign in for them), the song has no lyrics, or they are plain. get_formats and has_waveform only read: which formats members hold a song, album or artist in (counted once per member per format, from what their Viboplr measured), and whether a waveform is shared for a song. Neither needs sign-in. There is no tool to send a waveform or a format: Viboplr does that itself when a song plays without a waveform, if the user left Share waveforms on.

tools.name: get_formats
tools.description: Format stats from Viboplr Community: how many copies members hold, by quality tier (hires / lossless / lossy / unknown), codec, sample rate and bit depth. kind=all (default) is every song; kind=track needs title (+ artistName); kind=album needs name (+ artistName, the album artist); kind=artist needs name. Returns { found, copies, members, tiers, codecs, sampleRates, bitDepths } — found=false when Community knows nothing of it.

tools.name: has_waveform
tools.description: Whether Viboplr Community has a shared seek-bar waveform for a song, and for which recording lengths. Returns { title, artistName, shared, waveforms: [{ durationSecs }] }; who shared one is never said.

tools.name: publish_lyrics
tools.description: Publish the synced lyrics Viboplr has for a song to Viboplr Community (an update if already shared). Returns { status: "published" | "updated", id, url }. Needs the user signed in to Community; fails when the song has no synced lyrics.
